'''Kloofus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who served as the second-in-command of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Skinchanger]]''. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Prit Kessek]], a courier who worked for the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], and Kloofus accompanied the craft when it traveled to [[Bazarre]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Mosu system]], to pick up some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that were to be taken to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] on the behalf of the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]].
